name: Aleax
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Aleax Focus
traits.details: The aleax chooses one enemy as its focus at the start of the encounter. Its focus cannot change during the encounter.

traits.name: Aleax Invulnerability
traits.details: The aleax has total concealment from creatures other than its focus, and a +5 power bonus to all defenses against area attacks and close attacks from such creatures.

traits.name: Aleax Resilience
traits.details: At the start of each of the aleax’s turns, any effect on the aleax ends if the effect has a duration, but only if a creature other than the aleax’s focus caused it.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: The aleax regains 15 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. When the aleax takes damage from its focus or if it doesn’t attack its focus on its turn, its regeneration does not function on its next turn.

effect.description: The aleax attacks the target's lowest defense.
The aleax teleports up to 20 squares to a square adjacent to its focus.

powers.name: Divine Justice
powers.trigger: The aleax’s focus willingly leaves a square adjacent to the aleax or uses an attack power that does not include the aleax as a target.

effect.description: The aleax uses brilliant energy blade against its focus.

powers.name: Focus Resonance
powers.trigger: An attack from an enemy other than the aleax’s focus damages the aleax.

effect.description: The aleax’s focus takes damage equal to half the damage the attack dealt to the aleax.
